title: Cut CLAUDE.md to ~15K tokens
note: DONE in this PR: 547 KB -> 16.5 KB (~136K -> ~4.1K tokens). The generated SESSION-BRIEF block (39.4% of the file) and its generator scripts/ops/render_session_brief.py are deleted. Reference moved verbatim to docs/reference/. landed_unproven until a cold session is observed orienting from the cut file. [!] Shipped in PR #12668 (3ea2777). Still `landed_unproven`: merged is not observed, and for the doc rows the observation that matters is whether a SESSION can actually work from them -- which the next manager session is the first test of. [!] THE TEST WAS RUN, 2026-09-21/22, and this session IS the test the handoff named. VERDICT: WORKABLE. The cut CLAUDE.md carried this session end to end -- the instruction hierarchy, the two execution gates, the tier table and the pipeline section were each load-bearing and each sufficient without opening the reference docs. ⚠️ ONE REAL DEFECT FOUND, and it is about FRESHNESS rather than length: the file states claims WITH NUMBERS IN THEM that go stale in hours. Its Stage-2 paragraph said 'live 5 legs, mirror 14' when A6 had already made it 3, and its B2 paragraph said 'the roster does not yet' within hours of the roster being cut. Both corrected this session. A 15K file that is read first by every session is the worst place for a figure nobody re-measures -- the fix is to state the POPULATION and the command, not the number. [!] CLOSING THIS ROW MEANS a later session saying the same thing independently; one session's verdict is n=1. CHECKED 2026-09-25: at least 3 further sessions (09-22 B2, 09-24 E42, 09-24 B5) operated from the cut CLAUDE.md with no recorded confusion or resurrection of archived material -- consistent with, but not the same as, an explicit independent workability verdict. No session has written that verdict since the original 09-21/22 test. Still missing: one later session stating, in its own words, that the file carried it end to end. Check again the next time a fresh (non-resumed) session's close-out or sprint log speaks to onboarding from CLAUDE.md.
